coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 2 of 9 ground-truth variable items (22%): target properties (p-logP, QED, binding affinity) and structural diversity, including long-carbon-chain occurrence. Other required variables are missing or substantially changed.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Omits the fixed MOLGEN pipeline scripts and DeepSpeed configuration. Substitutes EGFR/GSK-3β for ESR1/ACAA1, uses different backbone and feedback comparisons rather than the specified model configurations, and omits the synthetic versus natural-product domain comparison. Reports Top-10/Top-100 rather than Top-3 scores and omits the specified binding-affinity improvements.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Provides no conclusion about MOLGEN's high p-logP scores, maintained or improved QED, lower KD values with approximately 96.7% and 70.4% improvements for ESR1 and ACAA1, mitigation of molecular hallucinations, or maintained diversity.
